constraints.scope: Real linear row-L1 bounds for unit input infinity norm using current coefficients promoted to F64. Not observed activation ranges or a guard/quantization guarantee.

factor_specification.canonical_state: Q=B I; B excludes both readout gains/permutations
factor_specification.inverse: Reverse layers: x1=y1-b*y0; x0=y0-a*x1; same live a/b, no dense inverse
factor_specification.derivative: Ordinary autograd through both lifting and inverse arithmetic, no detach/STE
factor_specification.numeric: FP32 multiply then add/subtract at each lifting step; F64 only for caller-requested references/conditioning.
factor_specification.scope: Arithmetic structure only. Condition, quantization, state widths, ports and complete-network AEE need separate measurement.

function.numeric: FP32 lifting multiply/add/subtract steps and gain readouts; all helper channel convolutions disable TF32. No dense temporal forward or runtime inverse.
function.state: Raw I; lifting source B temporary; consumer reads actual I+anchor BN2 branch through independent diagonal/P.
function.gate: Native theta_gate with each bias/center/actual theta amplitude; signed and zero gains retained.
function.branch: Caller deletes the complete BN2 branch at nonanchors, including offset; shared finish adds neither there.
function.frozen: Dense source/consumer A are references only; theta/center, BN gain/statistics, base biases and preview stay fixed.
function.boundary: A new FP32 student, not cond1 or a fixed-width implementation. Export reports coefficient-domain conditioning/bounds; actual ranges, guard bits, quantization and AEE remain to be measured. Shadows still execute in software.

training.optimizer: Fresh Adam1e-4 at each stage, seed912; 320 total updates, no checkpoint/validation selection
training.loss: Mean sqrt(sum_xy(flow-GT)^2+1e-6) on actual valid GT pixels; no distillation, sparsity/request loss or hyperparameter sweep
training.frozen: theta/center, four patch BN gains/stats, preview factors/PSN, all other network parameters

scope: New FP32 training/function and logical source counts. Shadow Conv2/BN are still executed; no hardware state deletion, RTL cycles, PPA or inherited ep34 AEE.
